sanskrit: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ prasūto brāhmaṇebhyo nir vapāmi | sa me mā kṣeṣṭa sadam aśyamānaḥ pitṝṇāṃ loke ||
english: By the impulsion of divine Savitṛ, impelled by the arms of the Aśvins, by the hands of Pūṣan, I offer thee forth to the Brāhmaṇas. May he never be exhausted for me, ever being eaten, in the world of the Pitṛs.

sanskrit: anumataṃ pṛthivyemaṃ pacāmy anu me dyaur manyatām anv antarikṣam | anu manyatām aditir devaputrā ime svarge loke astu ||
english: With the assent of Earth I cook this; may Heaven assent to me, may the Atmosphere assent. May Aditi, mother of the gods, assent; may these be in the heavenly world.

sanskrit: brahmaṇokhām adhi dadhāmy agnau bhūmyāṃ tvā bhūmim adhi dhārayāmi | agniḥ pacan rakṣatv odanam imaṃ rakṣaḥpiśācān nudatāṃ jātavedāḥ ||
english: I place the cooking-pot of Brahman upon the fire; upon the earth I uphold thee, upon earth. May Agni, as he cooks, protect this rice-offering; may Jātavedas drive away the Rakṣases and Piśācas.

sanskrit: acyutam akṣitaṃ viśvadānīm utsam iva sadam akṣīyamāṇam | pitā pitāmaha uta yas tṛtīyas ta enaṃ bhāgam upa jīvantu atra ||
english: Unfailing, undiminished, ever-giving, like a spring perpetually inexhaustible — let the father, the grandfather, and he who is the third ancestor live upon this share here.

sanskrit: prapīnam akṣitaṃ viśvadānīṃ somam iva punar āpyāyamānam | putraḥ pautra uta yaḥ prapautras teṣām astu nihito bhāga eṣaḥ ||
english: Swelling full, undiminished, ever-giving, replenishing itself again like Soma — let this deposited share belong to the son, the grandson, and him who is the great-grandson.

sanskrit: mā me jārīn nihito bhāga eṣa mānuṣanmānuṣad gupto astu | vaivasvate ni dadhe śevadhim etaṃ tasmā ut sṛjatu mahyam eva ||
english: Let not this deposited share of mine wear away; let it be guarded from human to human. I have laid this treasure with Vaivasvata; let him release it for me alone.

sanskrit: punaḥ pūryatāṃ yad adanty asya- -odano 'yaṃ tiṣṭhatv akṣitaḥ sadā | vaivasvatena gupto astu rājñā mamaitor upa jīvantu me svāḥ ||
english: Let it fill again what they eat of it; may this rice-offering ever remain undiminished. Let it be guarded by King Vaivasvata; may my own people live and come to me.

sanskrit: śatadhāraṃ sahasradhāram utsam akṣitaṃ vyacyamānaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe | ūrjaṃ duhānam anapasphurantam upāsīya sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaḥ ||
english: A spring of a hundred streams, of a thousand streams, undiminished, overflowing upon the surface of the waters, milking out nourishment without faltering — upon that I would attend, where the world of those who have done good deeds abides.
